overview_description.description:
ToDesktop enables web businesses to convert their web app into a desktop app.  With ToDesktop users can install web apps to their computer and launch it from the same place as other desktop apps on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Cork, Ireland.

product.name: ToDesktop Builder
product.description: A tool that converts web apps into cross-platform desktop apps with native features using a drag-and-drop interface and minimal coding.

product.name: ToDesktop Desktop APIs
product.description: A set of APIs that enable web apps converted with ToDesktop to access native desktop system features and customize app behavior.

product.name: ToDesktop Publishing and Distribution Platform
product.description: A platform that handles packaging, publishing, and distributing desktop apps with native installers, auto-updates, and analytics.
